error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup_description: Create the administrator account. You can invite other people once you're in.
setup_already_done: Setup has already been completed. Sign in instead.
sign_in_description: Use the account your Storyrr administrator created for you.
validation_url: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.
settings_services_description: Connect Storyrr to the apps that fetch and serve your books. Use the address Storyrr can reach them at, e.g. the container name and internal port on the same Docker network.
field_api_key_saved: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.
service_chaptarr_description: Fetches audiobooks and eBooks. API key: Chaptarr → Settings → General.
service_audiobookshelf_description: Tells Storyrr which audiobooks you already have. Use an API key from an admin user: Settings → API Keys.
service_error_auth_failed: {service} rejected the API key. Re-check it (it can change after {service}'s first-run setup).
service_error_not_found: {service} didn't answer at this address. Check the URL and port.
settings_metadata_description: Which Audible store audiobooks are searched in.
settings_audiobook_defaults_description: Where audiobook requests go unless an admin picks another folder.
settings_audiobook_defaults_needs_chapta: Connect Chaptarr first: folders and profiles come from it.
welcome_description: Your admin account is ready. Connect Chaptarr and Audiobookshelf now, or later in Settings.
request_error_not_configured: {service} isn't connected. An admin can set it up in Settings → Services.
request_error_defaults_missing: No default folder and profiles for audiobooks. An admin can set them in Settings → Services.
request_error_unsupported: This kind of request can't be sent yet.
request_not_found: This request doesn't exist or isn't yours.
request_cannot_cancel: Only pending requests can be cancelled.
request_invalid_transition: This request changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
request_auto_approved_info: This request will be approved automatically.
request_default_hint: Leave empty to use the default.
search_prompt_description: Search audiobooks on Audible and books, manga and comics on Hardcover.
requests_empty_description: Requests you make from search show up here with their progress.
settings_webhook_description: In Chaptarr, add a Webhook connection (Settings → Connect → Webhook, method POST, notify on import) with this URL, so requests turn available as soon as the book is imported. Keep it private: it contains a secret.
service_error_timeout: {service} didn't answer within {seconds} seconds. Check that the URL is the address Storyrr can reach it at (in Docker: the container name and internal port), and that {service} isn't busy.
service_error_unreachable: Couldn't connect to {service}. Check the URL and port, and that {service} is running.
service_kavita_description: Tells Storyrr which eBooks, manga and comics you already have. Use an Auth Key from Kavita → Settings → Account → Auth Keys.
test_ok_hardcover: Hardcover search works with this token.
settings_hardcover_description: eBook, manga and comics search uses Hardcover. Create a token on hardcover.app → Settings → Hardcover API; only the “read:catalog:search” permission is needed.
field_token_saved: Saved. Type a new one to replace it.
request_error_ebook_defaults_missing: No default folder and profiles for eBooks. An admin can set them in Settings → Services.
settings_ebook_defaults_description: Where eBook, manga and comics requests go unless an admin picks another folder (e.g. Books, Manga or Comics).
request_language_not_accepted: Chaptarr only accepts books in {languages}, and this one isn't available in it. Look for an edition in {languages}.
media_language_not_accepted: Not in {languages}: Chaptarr won't add it.
requests_delete_description: The request and its history are deleted from Storyrr. Nothing changes in Chaptarr.
requests_remove_description: Chaptarr stops monitoring this book in this format and forgets it (or drops its pending request). A request still on its way is cancelled.
requests_removed_shared: Removed from Chaptarr. Its pending request for this author also covers other books: delete it in Chaptarr (Wanted → Authors) if needed.
requests_remove_nothing: Chaptarr has nothing for this book anymore.
discover_empty_requests: No requests yet. Find something in Books or Audiobooks.
request_blocked: An admin blocked this title: it can't be requested.
blocklist_description: Titles nobody can request. Requests made before blocking are left as they are.
issue_not_found: This issue doesn't exist or isn't yours.
issues_description: Problems reported on titles of the library.
users_description: Accounts are invite-only: create one and hand over its temporary password.
users_not_yourself: You can't do that to your own account.
users_delete_description: The account, its requests and its issues are deleted. This can't be undone.
users_password_hint: At least {min} characters. Give it to them: they can't change it themselves yet.
request_quota_exceeded: You've reached your limit of {limit} requests every {days} days for this format. Try again later.
request_quota_left: {remaining} of {limit} requests left for the next {days} days.
settings_app_url_description: Set with the BETTER_AUTH_URL environment variable (used in links and the Chaptarr webhook).
settings_metadata_section_description: Where Storyrr searches books and audiobooks.
settings_chaptarr_description: Chaptarr fetches the audiobooks and eBooks users request. Pick where each format lands by default; admins can choose another folder when requesting or approving.
settings_chaptarr_delete_description: Storyrr forgets its address and API key. Books already sent stay in Chaptarr; new requests wait until you connect it again.
settings_audiobookshelf_libraries_descri: The Audiobookshelf libraries Storyrr scans to tell which audiobooks you already have. Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_kavita_libraries_description: The Kavita libraries Storyrr scans to tell which eBooks, manga and comics you already have. Save the connection first, then sync if none show up.
settings_libraries_empty: No library found on this server.
settings_users_description: Defaults for new accounts and how much each user can request.
settings_default_auto_approve_descriptio: Pre-checks “Approve their requests automatically” when adding a user.
users_limits_override: Use their own limits instead of the global ones
profile_email_description: Only an admin can change it for now.
profile_password_description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
profile_permissions_description: What your account can do. An admin changes it on the Users page.
users_own_password: Change your own password from your settings: it needs your current one.
users_set_password_description: Set a new password for this user, e.g. if they forgot theirs. Tell them the new one.
users_admin_description: Full access: approves requests and manages settings and users.
users_ban_description: Signs them out and blocks sign-in until unbanned.
users_limits_description: How many requests this user can make, instead of the global limits in Settings → Users.
about_issues: Report a bug or ask for a feature
about_releases_unavailable: Couldn't reach GitHub to list the releases.
metadata_providers_description: Where Storyrr finds books and audiobooks: Audible for audiobooks, Hardcover for eBooks, manga and comics.
